title: OneSteel Limited - proposed acquisition of Smorgon Steel Group Limited

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines. Market inquiries commenced.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC decision delayed pending further discussions with merger parties.
ACCC announced decision not to oppose proposed acquisition, subject to accepting court enforceable undertakings.

body_sections.Competition analysis: For detailed competition analysis, please see the Public Competition Assessment below.
